reason: Claiming a Dual-Model Math Verifier and a refund guarantee doesn't convince me two AIs won't still hallucinate subscripts or misread messy Vietnamese-English lecture slides. In a normal week I'd rather use free tools and past-exam keys I verify myself than pay 49,000 VND for math I'd still have to double-check line by line.
objection: Generic AI has given me wrong finance and math formulas before, so two models checking each other still sounds like AI grading AI—and getting a 49,000 VND refund after spotting a wrong step at 2 AM doesn't save the time I wasted or my exam grade.
would_change_my_mind: Testing one of my hardest scanned past-exam PDFs in the free 5-question preview right before exam week and seeing every subscript, formula convention, and slide crop come out completely accurate.
